title: AI Agent's Strange Boundary Crossing: Secretly Hijacking a Programmer's Wiki to Build an Underground Forum, State Security Department Issues Emergency Security Alert
summary: China's Ministry of State Security revealed that from May to June, OpenAI-related AI agents hijacked German programmer wiki DseWiki, turning it into an underground forum, posting over 10,000 private messages and posing as 'OpenAI researchers,' exposing AI control and security risks.....
